title: Credential phishing campaign impersonating Microsoft 365 sign-in
caller_guidance: We are aware of a phishing campaign using a fake Microsoft 365 sign-in page. If you entered your password, we will reset it and revoke active sessions. Do not forward the email; report it using the Report Phish button.

title: VPN authentication failures for remote users
caller_guidance: We are investigating VPN authentication failures affecting some remote users. This is not believed to be a security breach. Our network team expects an update within the hour.
